义项: 名词 辅音（与 vowel「元音」相对）
形容词 一致的；符合的（consonant with，正式书面用法）
搭配说明: vowel — n. 元音——真题对举（16 vowel and consonant sounds）
consonance / dissonance — n. 一致、和谐 / n. 不和谐（音乐术语亦用）

例句.英文: The Arapaho language of the Plains region in the United States has 16 vowel and consonant sounds.
例句.中文: 美国大平原地区的阿拉帕霍语有 16 个元音与辅音音位。

例句.英文: English dialects of the Upland South, a region stretching from Oklahoma to western Virginia, place similar emphasis on “r” at the ends of syllables and before other consonant sounds.
例句.中文: 上南方（从俄克拉何马绵延至弗吉尼亚西部的地区）的英语方言，同样着重音节末尾及其他辅音之前的 r 音。

义项: 动词 抵消、对抗、中和：通过施加相反的作用使某事物的效果失效
动词 (引申义) 抵制、消解（不良影响或趋势）
[构词] counter-（反）+ act（作用）→「反着作用」
搭配说明: counteraction — n. 抵消、对抗
counterpart — n. 对应的人 / 物——同前缀 counter- 但词义不同，别混
counteracting — v-ing 抵消——文法题真题另现（作后置定语，如 a compensatory measure counteracting the decline）

例句.英文: Such comparisons have engendered speculation that by diluting control over the economy, democratic institutions inhibit states' ability to counteract inflationary pressures.
例句.中文: 这样的对比引发了一种猜测：通过削弱国家对经济的控制，民主制度会抑制国家对抗通胀压力的能力。

义项: 动词 扩散；散布；传播（光、热、气味、思想）
形容词 弥漫的；散开的；（文章）冗长散漫的
搭配说明: diffusion — n. 扩散；传播（真题另现 6 次：cultural diffusion）
diffuse ≠ confuse — 形近异义：confuse 是「使困惑、混淆」

例句.英文: The shift from a top-down model of authorship to a more diffuse, interactive one explicitly positioned readers as creators of meaning and implicitly acknowledged the broader social contexts around literary production.
例句.中文: 作者身份从自上而下的模式转向一种更为分散、更具互动性的模式，这一转变明确把读者定位为意义的创造者，也含蓄地承认了文学生产所处的更广阔的社会语境。

义项: 名词 多样化；分化（物种、语言、经济、投资）
[构词] diverse（多样的）→ diversify（v.）→ diversification（n.）
搭配说明: diversify / diversity — v. 使多样化 / n. 多样性
drive diversification — 推动分化——真题搭配

例句.英文: Thus, the geographical circumstances that favor the development of isolates may also drive diversification within language families.
例句.中文: 因此，有利于孤立语发展的地理条件，也可能推动语系内部的分化。

例句.英文: To study the joint environmental and economic effects of diversification practices (which can encompass improved soil and water management as well as increased variety in crops and livestock), Laura Vang Rasmussen and team analyzed data from 2,655 farms in eleven countries.
例句.中文: 为研究多样化实践（可包括更好的土壤与水管理，以及作物和牲畜种类的增加）对环境与经济的共同影响，Laura Vang Rasmussen 团队分析了来自 11 个国家 2,655 个农场的数据。

义项: 动词 引出；诱出（反应、回答、兴趣、情感）
动词 elicit a response / elicit interest 引发反应 / 激起兴趣
搭配说明: elicit ≠ illicit — 形近异义经典陷阱：illicit 是「非法的」
elicit vs evoke — elicit 强调「把反应引出来」，evoke 强调「唤起记忆 / 情感」

例句.英文: In their meta-analysis of research on advergames (video games developed to promote products or services), Zeph M. C. van Berlo et al. confirm that such games, though they can elicit player interest, may not facilitate subsequent recall of product and brand information.
例句.中文: 在关于 advergames（为推广产品或服务而开发的电子游戏）研究的元分析中，Zeph M.C. van Berlo 等人确认：这类游戏虽然能够激发玩家兴趣，却未必有助于玩家日后回忆产品与品牌信息。

例句.英文: Subsequent to simulating an attack to elicit defense responses in three caterpillar species, ecologists placed a treatment group of those individuals in an enclosure where they were exposed to slight, harmless ambient electric field shifts like those created by common predatory wasps in flight.
例句.中文: 为诱发三种毛虫的防御反应，生态学家先模拟了一次攻击；随后把这些毛虫的处理组放入围栏，让它们暴露于轻微无害的环境电场变化中——类似常见捕食性胡蜂飞行时产生的电场扰动。

义项: 动词 使成化石；变成化石
动词 (引申义) 使僵化；使变得陈旧（fossilized ideas 僵化的观念）
搭配说明: fossil — n. 化石；fossilization n. 石化（作用）
fossilized remains — 化石遗骸——真题搭配

例句.英文: Scientists looking for signs of ancient life in Asia have found many examples of fossilized hominins, including in a geological formation at the Minatogawa Limestone Quarry.
例句.中文: 在亚洲寻找远古生命迹象的科学家已发现许多古人类化石，其中包括港川石灰岩采石场某处地质构造中的化石。

例句.英文: In 1990, archaeologists in Lesotho, in southern Africa, discovered a fossilized phalanx of a Massospondylus carinatus dinosaur in a cave once inhabited by humans.
例句.中文: 1990 年，考古学家在南部非洲的莱索托一处曾有人类居住的洞穴中，发现了一块恐龙（Massospondylus carinatus）的指骨化石。

义项: 动词 拾（收割后散落的谷穗）→ 一点一滴地搜集（信息、线索）
动词 glean insights / trends：从数据或材料中逐步获取认识
动词 拾食；啄食（bark gleaning / foliage gleaning 真题专业用法）
搭配说明: gleaner — n. 拾穗者；搜集者
glean ≠ clean — 形近，勿在考场上看走眼

例句.英文: The Canadian Longitudinal Study on Aging (CLSA-ÉLCV) is a longitudinal study surveying approximately 1,000 individuals in Canada to glean extended trends in aging.
例句.原书高亮: to glean extended trends in aging
例句.中文: 加拿大老龄化纵向研究（CLSA-ÉLCV）是一项纵向研究，对加拿大约 1,000 名个体进行调查，以逐步摸清老龄化方面的长期趋势。

例句.英文: Glyphorynchus spirurus (the wedge-billed woodcreeper), on the other hand, practices bark gleaning (picking insects off the bark of trees), substantially limiting the bird's field of vision while foraging.
例句.中文: 而楔嘴䴕雀则采取树皮拾取式觅食（从树皮上啄取昆虫），觅食时视野受到极大限制。

义项: 形容词 由不同成分组成的；异质的；混杂的
[构词] hetero-（异）+ gen（种类）+ -ous
搭配说明: homogeneous — adj. 同质的；均匀的——反义词，常成对出现
heterogeneity — n. 异质性；heterogeneous ≠ heterogeneous 与 heterogeneous 同族

例句.英文: Richard Hosier and Jeffrey Dowd's study of fuel use in Zimbabwe shows how reductive this model is, however: household fuel use was heterogeneous, flexible, and influenced by several factors, including the local prices of different fuel sources.
例句.原书高亮: household fuel use was heterogeneous, flexible
例句.中文: 然而，Richard Hosier 与 Jeffrey Dowd 对津巴布韦燃料使用情况的研究表明，这一模型是何等简化：家庭燃料使用是混杂而灵活的，并受到包括不同燃料当地价格在内的多种因素影响。

义项: 释义 作家成名前、青少年时期创作的作品，常作为研究其艺术成长的素材
释义 带贬义：风格不成熟的作品

例句.英文: Scholarly interest in literary juvenilia—writings by children and teenagers—tends to focus on unpublished works by authors who became famous as adults, such as Charles Dickens’s poem “The Bill of Fare,” which he wrote around the ages of 18-20, because they offer insights into their authors’ artistic development.
例句.中文: 学界对文学少年习作——儿童与青少年所写的作品——的兴趣，往往集中于那些后来成名的作家未发表的作品，例如查尔斯·狄更斯 18 至 20 岁左右所写的诗《菜单》，因为这些作品为了解作者的艺术成长提供了线索。

例句.英文: But some scholars also argue that recovering juvenilia by lesser-known writers is essential to understanding literary history: Daisy Ashford's novels, which she published as a child, were widely read by contemporaries and are therefore deserving of closer attention.
例句.中文: 但也有学者主张，挖掘知名度较低作家的少年习作对理解文学史必不可少：Daisy Ashford 童年发表的小说曾广为同时代读者阅读，因此值得更密切的关注。

义项: 动词 传播；扩散（波、声音、光、思想）
动词 繁殖；增殖（propagate plants by cuttings）
搭配说明: propagation — n. 传播；繁殖
propagate ≠ propagate to — 真题取「（波）传播」义，不是「宣传」
disseminate — v. 散布（信息）——近义

例句.英文: Studies of ocean wave breaking have predominantly focused on traveling waves (those propagating along the horizontal plane), so Mark McAllister et al. utilized a circular wave tank to produce and study spike waves, axisymmetric standing waves that can erupt vertically when traveling waves propagating in opposing directions intersect.
例句.原书高亮: those propagating along the horizontal plane
例句.中文: 对海浪破碎的研究主要关注的是行波（即沿水平面传播的波），因此 Mark McAllister 等人使用了圆形波槽来生成并研究尖峰波：这是一种轴对称驻波，当沿相反方向传播的行波相交时，会垂直喷涌而起。

例句.英文: High-entropy alloys (HEAs) have been observed to have greater fracture toughness—greater resistance to crack propagation—than conventional alloys.
例句.中文: 据观察，高熵合金（HEA）比常规合金具有更强的断裂韧性——即更强的抗裂纹扩展能力。

义项: 形容词 讽刺的；含讽刺意味的（satirical portrayal / novel）
[辨析] satirical 是形容词，satire 是名词「讽刺（作品）」，satirize 是动词
搭配说明: satire / satirize — n. 讽刺（作品）/ v. 讽刺
satirical ≠ saturnine — 后者意为「阴沉的、忧郁的」，形近易混

例句.英文: The Vortex is a 1924 satirical play by Noel Coward.
例句.中文: 《漩涡》（The Vortex）是诺埃尔·科沃德 1924 年的一部讽刺剧。

义项: 形容词 随处可见、普遍存在的
[辨析] 语气强于 common：真题用 is ubiquitous in domestic dog breeds 强调「几乎所有犬种都有」

例句.英文: Ostrander et al. assert that this explanation is flawed, having discovered that a mutation responsible for variants of IGF1, a gene found in many mammals that regulates production of insulin-like growth factor 1, is ubiquitous in domestic dog breeds.
例句.中文: Ostrander 等人认为这一解释站不住脚：他们发现，一个导致 IGF1（一种存在于许多哺乳动物体内、调控胰岛素样生长因子 1 生成的基因）变异的突变，在家犬各品种中普遍存在。

例句.英文: However, Nunez and colleagues claim that this tendency is not in fact ubiquitous.
例句.中文: 然而 Nunez 及同事声称，这一倾向实际上并非无处不在。

义项: 动词 位于…之下；构成…的基础；是…的根本原因
动词 几乎只用 underlying 这一形容词形态（真题 10 次）
搭配说明: underlying — adj. 潜在的；根本的（the underlying pulse 潜在的基本律动）
underlie ≠ underline — 后者是「在…下划线；强调」

例句.英文: This hypothesis was based on findings about a specific form of rhythmic complexity known as syncopation (when beats played in the rhythm deviate from the steady, underlying pulse of a song), which suggested that moderate syncopation was associated with the highest groove ratings.
例句.原书高亮: the steady, underlying pulse of a song
例句.中文: 这一假说基于对一种特定节奏复杂形式——切分（即所奏节拍偏离歌曲稳定而潜在的基本律动）——的研究发现，该发现表明中等程度的切分与最高的律动感评分相关。

例句.英文: The CNN model's output aligned with results of prior studies by other researchers measuring muscle activity patterns directly—one of several indications, said Melis et al., that the model accurately represents important biomechanical processes underlying wing motion.
例句.中文: CNN 模型的输出与其他研究者直接测量肌肉活动模式的既有研究相符——Melis 等人称，这是该模型准确表征翅膀运动背后重要生物力学过程的诸多迹象之一。

义项: 动词 （因受力）轻微晃动、摆动
名词 radial velocity method 通过恒星 tiny wobbles 推断绕行行星的引力拖拽

例句.英文: The radial velocity method detects tiny wobbles in stars caused by orbiting planets pulling on them.
例句.原书高亮: detects tiny wobbles in stars caused
例句.中文: 径向速度法通过探测恒星因绕行行星引力牵引而产生的微小摆动来发现行星。

例句.英文: As the exoplanet 17 Scorpii b orbits a star 408 light-years from Earth, the gas giant’s gravity causes the star to wobble.
例句.中文: 当系外行星 17 Scorpii b 环绕一颗距地球 408 光年的恒星运行时，这颗气态巨行星的引力使恒星发生摆动。

义项: 名词 认知与语言语境：知识、技能或记忆的获得过程（the acquisition of new memories, language acquisition）
名词 商业语境：一家企业买下另一家企业（mergers and acquisitions）
名词 博物馆或图书馆语境：新入藏的藏品

例句.英文: A soil’s microbial community (the microbial taxa present in their relative abundances) is known to affect plants’ nutrient acquisition.
例句.中文: 众所周知，土壤的微生物群落（即其中存在的各微生物类群及其相对丰度）会影响植物对养分的获取。

例句.英文: Cognitive scientists have noted, however, that existing domain knowledge facilitates the acquisition of new information in that domain.
例句.中文: 然而认知科学家指出，已有的领域知识会促进该领域新信息的获取。

义项: 形容词 可归因于…的（attributable to X）
形容词 solely / largely attributable to 完全 / 主要归因于
搭配说明: attribute — v. 把…归因于（attribute X to Y）；n. 属性、特征
attribution — n. 归因；（作品）归属判定

例句.英文: Finding that knockout mice with the gene Aasdh deactivated tended to develop cataracts more frequently than did wild-type mice, the students concluded that differences in cataract frequency among house mice in nature are solely attributable to variations in the level of expression of Aasdh.
例句.中文: 学生们发现，Aasdh 基因被敲除的小鼠比野生型小鼠更容易患白内障，由此得出结论：自然界中家鼠白内障发生频率的差异完全可归因于 Aasdh 表达水平的差异。

义项: 名词 被某一共同体公认具有权威性的作品序列（the modernist canon, the literary canon）
名词 某一领域公认的标准（the canons of evidence）
名词 宗教语境：教会确认的经典或法规

例句.英文: For too long, scholars have focused on experimental versus conventional poetic forms, inhibiting inquiry into other points of stylistic correspondence among poems that would enrich our understanding of the modernist canon.
例句.中文: 长期以来，学者们专注于实验性诗体与传统诗体的对立，从而阻碍了对诗歌之间其他文体对应关系的探究——而这些探究本可丰富我们对现代主义正典的理解。

例句.英文: His book The Canon of Medicine recorded the most advanced medical knowledge of his time.
例句.中文: 他的《医典》一书收录了当时最先进的医学知识。

义项: 动词 迷住；使着迷；俘虏（人心）
[构词] capt-（抓、拿）+ -ivate → 把注意力抓住
搭配说明: captivating — adj. 迷人的——真题 18 次全为此形
captive / capture — n. 俘虏、adj. 被囚禁的 / v. 捕获

例句.英文: However, in other works, Villasana honors ordinary people, as she does in her captivating portrayal of a woman making tortillas.
例句.原书高亮: her captivating portrayal of a woman making tortillas
例句.中文: 不过在其他作品中，Villasana 也致敬普通人，正如她在那幅令人着迷的画作中呈现的一位正在做玉米饼的女性。

义项: 形容词 concurrent with 与……同时发生；两件事在时间上重叠
形容词 concurrent trends 并行出现的两种趋势，未必互相影响
形容词 法律语境：concurrent jurisdiction 并行管辖权，两个法院同时有权审理

例句.英文: Cross-references of that information with both archaeological and paleoecological records have revealed significant increases in clam size and productivity concurrent with the most prevalent use of these clam gardens.
例句.原书高亮: and productivity concurrent with the most
例句.中文: 将这些信息与考古记录、古生态记录交叉比对后发现，蛤蜊体型与生产力的显著上升，与这些蛤蜊养殖场使用最普遍的时期同时发生。

例句.英文: They found that using multiple diversification practices concurrently had greater potential for improving both nonagricultural biodiversity and yields than using a single strategy did.
例句.中文: 他们发现，同时采用多种多样化实践，在改善非农业生物多样性和产量方面，比采用单一策略有更大的潜力。

义项: 形容词 同时期的；同时代的（contemporaneous with X）
[辨析] contemporaneous 强调「两者时间重合」；contemporary 还可指「当代的」
搭配说明: contemporary — adj./n. 当代的 / 同时代的人
contemporaneously — adv. 同一时期地

例句.英文: Archaeologists have observed similarities in the tools, such as bidirectional blades, uncovered at the Neolithic-period Mesopotamian settlement of Çayönü Tepesi and those uncovered at roughly contemporaneous settlements elsewhere in Southwest Asia, including those in the South Levant, Central Anatolia, and Central Zagros.
例句.中文: 考古学家观察到，在新石器时代美索不达米亚定居点恰约尼丘（Çayönü Tepesi）出土的工具（如双向石叶），与西南亚其他地区大致同时期的定居点——包括南黎凡特、安纳托利亚中部和扎格罗斯中部的定居点——出土的工具存在相似之处。

义项: 形容词 错综复杂的；盘绕曲折的（情节、论证、结构）
形容词 盘绕的；回旋状的（convoluted shells）
搭配说明: convolution — n. 盘绕；回旋（亦指脑回）
convoluted ≠ involved — involved 是「参与的；复杂的」，不要混写

例句.英文: President Richard Nixon is most famous for his participation in the 1970s Watergate political scandal, a convoluted tale of criminality and eroded ethics involving a constellation of associates such as security operative Jack Caulfield and Attorney General John Mitchell.
例句.中文: 理查德·尼克松总统最为人所知的是他在 1970 年代水门政治丑闻中的角色——那是一个盘根错节的犯罪与道德沦丧的故事，牵涉到一整批相关人物，如安全特工杰克·考尔菲尔德和司法部长约翰·米切尔。

义项: 名词 金融与法律核心义：未能按期偿付债务（debt defaults, default on a loan）
名词 技术语境：未作选择时系统预设的状态（by default）
名词 法律语境：未履行义务或未出庭（default judgment 缺席判决）

例句.英文: Mauricio Drelichman and Hans-Joachim Voth's research into the debt defaults of Philip II (who ruled an empire including Spain and Milan from 1556 to 1598) relates to other work on European early modern state finance, including Eugene White's research on surpluses and state borrowing.
例句.原书高亮: the debt defaults of Philip II
例句.中文: 毛里西奥·德雷利希曼与汉斯-约阿希姆·福斯对腓力二世（1556 至 1598 年统治包括西班牙和米兰在内的帝国）债务违约的研究，与其他关于欧洲近代早期国家财政的著述相关联，其中包括尤金·怀特关于财政盈余与国家借贷的研究。

义项: 形容词 创业的；具有企业家精神的
形容词 entrepreneurial training / education 创业培训 / 创业教育
搭配说明: entrepreneur / entrepreneurship — n. 创业者 / n. 创业精神、创业活动
entrepreneurial ≠ enterprising — 后者是「有进取心的」，近义但不完全等同

例句.英文: For instance, a 1998 study by Ove Hansemark found benefits of entrepreneurial education for Swedish college students, but the study used a very small sample of only 19 students, making it difficult to say whether the training actually had an effect.
例句.中文: 例如，Ove Hansemark 在 1998 年的一项研究发现创业教育对瑞典大学生有益，但该研究样本极小，仅 19 名学生，因此很难断言这种培训是否真的产生了效果。

例句.英文: In a study of business school graduates in Norway, researchers Lars Kolvereid and Øystein Moen addressed this question and convincingly demonstrated that participants showed strong intentions to become entrepreneurs as a result of receiving entrepreneurial training.
例句.中文: 在一项针对挪威商学院毕业生的研究中，Lars Kolvereid 与 Øystein Moen 探讨了这一问题，并令人信服地证明：参与者因接受创业培训而表现出强烈的成为创业者的意向。

义项: 动词 侵蚀；腐蚀（水、风对土壤岩石的侵蚀）
动词 (引申义) 逐渐削弱、损害（权力、信任、道德、支持率）
搭配说明: erosion — n. 侵蚀；削弱（真题高频）
eroded ethics — 道德沦丧——真题搭配

例句.英文: A meander forms when water erodes sediment from one side of the riverbank and redeposits that sediment on the opposite side.
例句.中文: 当水流侵蚀河岸一侧的沉积物、再把这些沉积物重新堆积到对岸时，就形成了河曲。

义项: 形容词 （文本、物种、作品等）现存的；尚存的
形容词 extinct 已灭绝的 / 已失传的——extant 最直接的反义词
形容词 extant ≠ extent（程度 / 范围），SAT 经典拼写陷阱
搭配说明: extinct / extirpate — adj. 灭绝的 / v. 根除、使（种群）灭绝
surviving — adj. 现存的——同义替换，常作正确选项的等价表达

例句.英文: Most of the island’s extant biota belong to clades with younger crown ages, however: Jérôme Murienne et al. found that the crown age of Grande Terre’s clade of cockroaches is 2.7 million years, for example.
例句.中文: 不过，该岛现存生物区系大多属于冠群年龄较年轻的支系：例如 Jérôme Murienne 等人发现，格朗德特尔岛蟑螂支系的冠群年龄只有 270 万年。

例句.英文: The Roman historian Suetonius's De vita caesarum, a biography of the Roman Empire's first leaders, is an extant work: it can still be read.
例句.中文: 罗马历史学家苏维托尼乌斯的《十二凯撒传》是罗马帝国首批统治者的传记，是一部 extant（存世）作品：至今仍可阅读。

义项: 形容词 比喻的；修辞的（figurative language 比喻性语言）
形容词 具象的、写实的（与 abstract「抽象的」相对）
搭配说明: figuratively — adv. 比喻地；figurative ≠ literal（字面的）
figure of speech — 修辞手法

例句.英文: In one portion of the novel, Toomer uses figurative language to connect the narrator's urban environment of Washington.
例句.中文: 在小说的某一段落中，Toomer 运用比喻性语言把叙述者所处的华盛顿城市环境串联起来。

义项: 名词 荧光（solar-induced chlorophyll fluorescence, SIF 日光诱导叶绿素荧光）
[构词] fluor-（氟 / 荧光）+ -escence（开始…的状态）
搭配说明: fluorescent / fluoresce — adj. 发荧光的 / v. 发荧光
fluorescence ≠ fluorescence microscopy — 后者是「荧光显微术」
GPP / proxy — 总初级生产力 / n. 替代指标——真题同现

例句.英文: But as flux towers aren’t evenly distributed globally, alternate proxies for GPP obtained remotely from satellite sensors, including solar-induced chlorophyll fluorescence (SIF) emitted by plants during photosynthesis, are being investigated.
例句.中文: 但由于通量塔在全球分布并不均匀，人们正在研究通过卫星传感器遥感获取的总初级生产力（GPP）替代指标，其中包括植物在光合作用中发出的日光诱导叶绿素荧光（SIF）。

例句.英文: Some transgenic fish have genes from jellyfish that result in fluorescence (that is, they glow in the dark.) Although these fish were initially engineered for research purposes in the 1990s, they were sold as pets in the 2000s and can now be found in the wild in creeks in Brazil.
例句.中文: 一些转基因鱼携带来自水母的基因，因而能发光（即在黑暗中荧光闪烁）。这些鱼在 1990 年代最初为科研目的而培育，2000 年代被当作宠物出售，如今在巴西的溪流中已能发现野生个体。

义项: 动词 摄入；吞下（食物、药物、物质）
[辨析] ingest 是「吃进体内」，digest 是「消化」——先后两步
搭配说明: ingestion — n. 摄入——真题另现 11 次
ingested / ingesting — 过去式 / 现在分词

例句.英文: CLPs are transmitted when an infected host is ingested by an individual of another species, typically shielding CLPs from the external environment, whereas directly transmitted parasites are exposed to external conditions during transmission.
例句.原书高亮: when an infected host is ingested
例句.中文: 当受感染的宿主被另一物种的个体吞食时，CLP 便得以传播——这种方式通常使 CLP 与外部隔绝；而直接传播的寄生虫在传播过程中则暴露于外部环境条件之下。

例句.英文: So in one day, a humpback whale weighing 30,000 kg could eat 9,000 kg, while a northern right whale weighing 80,000 kg could ingest a whopping 24,000 kg.
例句.中文: 因此一天之内，一头重 3 万公斤的座头鲸可吃掉 9000 公斤食物，而一头重 8 万公斤的北大西洋露脊鲸可吞下高达 2.4 万公斤。

义项: 动词 激起…的兴趣；使好奇、着迷
名词 阴谋；密谋（political intrigue）
搭配说明: intriguing — adj. 引人入胜的；耐人寻味的——真题 4 次
intrigue ≠ intricate — 后者是「错综复杂的」，形近异义

例句.英文: Tomi Adeyemi's first published work, the inventive West African-inspired fantasy novel Children of Blood and Bone, has intriguing things to say about the relationship between identity and power.
例句.中文: Tomi Adeyemi 首部出版的作品——构思新颖、以西非为灵感的奇幻小说《Children of Blood and Bone》——对身份与权力之间的关系道出了颇为耐人寻味的见解。

例句.英文: While studying the distribution of a particular cactus species, Echinocactus grusonii, researchers have come to intriguing observations.
例句.中文: 在研究金琥（Echinocactus grusonii）这一仙人掌物种的分布时，研究者得出了一些耐人寻味的观察。

义项: 动词 滤出；渗滤（leach into waterways / soils）
动词 (引申义) （从…中）榨取；逐渐抽走（leach nutrients from soil）
搭配说明: leaching — n. 淋溶（作用）
leach ≠ leech — 同音异形，后者是「水蛭；寄生虫」
leachate — n. 渗滤液——环保工程术语

例句.英文: Some toothpastes contain titanium dioxide nanoparticles (TiO₂-NPs), which can leach into waterways and soils via wastewater.
例句.原书高亮: can leach into waterways and soils via wastewater
例句.中文: 某些牙膏含有二氧化钛纳米颗粒（TiO₂-NPs），它们会经由废水渗入水道与土壤。

义项: 形容词 发光的；明亮的（luminous galactic nuclei / relatives）
形容词 (引申义) （文风、色彩）明澈通透的
搭配说明: luminosity — n. 光度；亮度——天文类术语
luminous ≠ luminescent — 后者指「发冷光的（生物 / 化学）」，真题亦现
illuminate / luminous — v. 照亮 / adj. 发光的——同根

例句.英文: Quasars--such as APM 08279+5255, located in the Lynx constellation--are extremely luminous galactic nuclei powered by supermassive black holes, some of which are known to have developed within the first billion years of the formation of the universe.
例句.中文: 类星体——例如位于天猫座的 APM 08279+5255——是由超大质量黑洞驱动的、光度极高的星系核，其中一些已知形成于宇宙诞生后的第一个十亿年内。

义项: 动词 讲述（故事、事件），narrate a portion of text
[构词] narration n. 叙述；narrator n. 叙述者；与 recount 相比更强调「以某一视角讲出来」

例句.英文: Victor Frankenstein, who narrates this portion of text, describes the state of scientific knowledge as he began his own study of the natural world.
例句.中文: 维克多·弗兰肯斯坦正在叙述这段文字，他描述了自己开始研究自然界时科学知识的状况。

例句.英文: The Iowa Writers’ Workshop, an influential graduate program in creative writing, has been criticized for almost exclusively promoting fiction that is conventional in its narrative structure.
例句.中文: 爱荷华作家工作坊这一极具影响力的创意写作研究生项目，一直因几乎只推崇叙事结构因循传统的小说而受到批评。

义项: 动词 渗透；弥漫于（be permeated with）
动词 (引申义) （气息、情绪）充满、浸透
搭配说明: permeation / permeable — n. 渗透 / adj. 可渗透的——真题亦现
permeate ≠ permeated with — 真题作 be permeated with 浸透着
suffuse / imbue — v. 弥漫于 / v. 使充满——近义，真题亦现
permeability — 同词根构词变体，真题出现 7 次；已并入本词条统一计数

例句.英文: However, any barrier used must allow the thread-like hyphae of a CMN to pass through, and this permeability would also allow liquids through.
例句.中文: 然而，所使用的任何屏障都必须能让 CMN 的丝状菌丝通过，而这种可渗透性同样会让液体通过。

例句.英文: As the process continues, water from the food's center moves to the crust as long as the crust remains permeable.
例句.中文: 随着这一过程持续进行，只要外皮保持可渗透，食物中心的水分就会向外皮迁移。

义项: 形容词 （法律、规则）允许的、不算违规的
[辨析] 真题 though legally permissible, nonetheless… 是典型让步结构：合法 ≠ 正当；反义 impermissible

例句.英文: Philosopher Ingrid Robeyns disapproves of the use of tax havens as a method of tax avoidance that, though legally permissible, nonetheless helps investors to sidestep payment toward government upkeep.
例句.中文: 哲学家 Ingrid Robeyns 不认可把利用避税港作为避税手段：这种做法虽在法律上被允许，却仍帮助投资者规避了本应负担的政府开支。

例句.英文: Philosophers note that many people have an intuitive sense that while we ought not to lie, there may be circumstances in which lying is permissible.
例句.中文: 哲学家们指出，许多人都凭直觉感到：我们固然不应当说谎，但某些情形下说谎或许是可容许的。

义项: 名词 预防措施、防范手段：为免出现坏结果而事先做的事
名词 (引申义) 预防、防备（as a precaution 以防万一）
[搭配] take the precaution of doing sth 采取……的预防措施；as a precaution 作为预防
搭配说明: precautionary — adj. 预防性的（precautionary measures 预防措施）

例句.英文: Meng and colleagues took the necessary precaution of separating the plants’ root systems (thereby excluding root-to-root transmission).
例句.中文: Meng 及其同事采取了必要的预防措施——把植物的根系分隔开（从而排除根与根之间的传递）。

义项: 名词 落水洞；溶洞、塌陷坑（blue holes 蓝洞即大型海水 sinkholes）
[构词] sink（下沉）+ hole（洞）
搭配说明: blue hole — 蓝洞——真题与之同现
subterranean — adj. 地下的——真题另现
sinkhole ≠ sinkhole of — 真题作 large seawater sinkholes

例句.英文: Blue holes, such as the Far Side Blue Hole in the Abaco Islands, are large seawater sinkholes that tend to have varying water density and irregularities in their steep walls.
例句.中文: 蓝洞（如阿巴科群岛的 Far Side 蓝洞）是大型海水落水洞，其水体密度往往层层不同，陡壁上也常见不规则的凹凸。

例句.英文: With examples ranging from Dean’s Blue Hole in the Bahamas to Nancy’s Blue Hole in the Abaco Islands, blue holes are large underwater sinkholes: pits filled with dark blue water that contrasts with lighter blue shallower waters surrounding them.
例句.中文: 从巴哈马的迪恩蓝洞到阿巴科群岛的南希蓝洞，蓝洞是巨大的水下天坑：坑中充满深蓝色的水，与周围较浅的浅蓝色海水形成鲜明反差。

义项: 动词 使位于；把…置于（某语境、背景、位置中）——常用被动 be situated
动词 situating X in a larger context 把 X 置于更大的语境中
搭配说明: situated — adj. 位于…的；处于…境地的——真题主要形态
situation — n. 处境；形势；地理位置

例句.英文: Some finches' nests were situated close to the new road and others were deeper in the woodland.
例句.原书高亮: were situated close to the new road
例句.中文: 有些雀鸟的巢筑在紧邻新修道路的地方，另一些则位于林地更深处。

例句.英文: A student is writing a research paper on the history of irrigation in the southwestern United States, situating the development of Lake Sabrina (a man-made body of water created in Inyo County).
例句.中文: 一位学生正在撰写关于美国西南部灌溉史的研究论文，将萨布丽娜湖（因约县一处人工修建的水体）的开发置于其中加以考察。

义项: 名词 （书面、带道德意味）怠惰、懒散，七宗罪之一
名词 树懒（three-toed sloths）；真题以动物名出现，两义并考是常见手法

例句.英文: Bentley examined research on brown-throated three-toed sloths and canaries to see whether results from studies in the wild were consistent with the results of studies in the laboratory.
例句.原书高亮: brown-throated three-toed sloths and canaries to
例句.中文: Bentley 查阅了关于褐喉三趾树懒与金丝雀的研究，以检验野外实验的结果是否与实验室结果一致。

例句.英文: The factors that contributed to the extinction of the Caribbean ground sloth around 3000 BCE, for example, may be applicable to endangered species today.
例句.中文: 例如，导致加勒比地懒约公元前 3000 年灭绝的因素，或许同样适用于今天的濒危物种。

义项: 动词 挖掘出；掘出（埋藏的器物、遗骸）
动词 (引申义) 发现；揭露（事实、真相、证据）
搭配说明: unearth ≠ disinter — 后者专指「掘出（尸体）」，语域更窄
dig up — 短语动词「挖出；查出」，同义替换

例句.英文: Some stayed buried for many centuries, such as the Parc-y-Meirch hoard, which was unearthed around 1868, and the Fittleworth hoard, discovered in 1995.
例句.中文: 有些窖藏在地下埋藏了许多个世纪，例如约 1868 年出土的 Parc-y-Meirch 窖藏，以及 1995 年发现的 Fittleworth 窖藏。

例句.英文: Deposits of valuable objects, or hoards, have been unearthed in many different parts of Ireland and Northern Ireland.
例句.中文: 珍贵物品的埋藏堆，即窖藏，已在爱尔兰和北爱尔兰的许多不同地区出土。

义项: 名词 抽象；抽象概念
名词 抽象手法；抽象艺术（a mode of abstraction 一种抽象方式）
搭配说明: abstract — adj. 抽象的 / n. 摘要 / v. 提取
abstract art / abstractionism — 抽象艺术 / 抽象主义

例句.英文: Many contemporary Indigenous painters practice a specifically indigenous mode of abstraction; for example, Linda Lomahaftewa often assembles compositions out of motifs common in the ceramics and other traditional arts of the Hopi Tribe.
例句.原书高亮: a specifically indigenous mode of abstraction
例句.中文: 许多当代原住民画家践行一种特有的原住民式抽象：例如，Linda Lomahaftewa 常以霍皮族陶器及其他传统艺术中常见的母题来组织画面。

例句.英文: In this respect, the work typifies Indigenous painters’ forays into abstraction during the period.
例句.中文: 在这一方面，该作品是那一时期原住民画家探索抽象艺术的典型代表。

义项: 形容词 宁静的、安详的：平静无波、不受扰动（the serene speaker 宁静安适的抒情者；the mood is serene 氛围宁静）
[构词] 拉丁 serenus「晴朗无云的」（天色澄澈）→ 引申为「平静、安详」；名词 serenity 宁静
搭配说明: serenity — n. 宁静、安详（serenity of mind 心境平和）
serenely — adv. 宁静地、安详地
辨析 — serene 多修饰氛围、神态、心境（mood / expression / landscape），比 calm 更书面，强调「澄澈无扰」

例句.英文: Contemplating the beauty of a natural landscape, the serene speaker of William Wordsworth’s poem “Lines Composed a Few Miles above Tintern Abbey” (1798) seems wholly insulated from society.
例句.中文: 沉醉于自然美景之中，威廉·华兹华斯《丁登寺旁》（1798）一诗里宁静安适的抒情者，似乎完全隔绝于人类社会之外。

例句.英文: She paints the water with vivid blue colors, including sapphire blue and ultramarine. The mood in the paintings is serene.
例句.中文: 她以鲜艳的蓝色画水——如蓝宝石蓝与群青色。这些画作的整体氛围宁静安详。

义项: 名词 群岛；列岛（含其间的海域）
[辨析] archipelago 是一组岛，island 是单个岛
搭配说明: the Hawaiian archipelago — 夏威夷群岛——真题搭配
island chain — 岛链——同义表达

例句.英文: Like many other bird species that live only on the Hawaiian archipelago, the Kaua‘i ‘amakihi has adapted to life in a well-defined habitat, resulting in highly specialized physical and behavioral characteristics that aid the species in survival.
例句.中文: 与许多只生活在夏威夷群岛的鸟类一样，考岛绿雀（Kauaʻi ʻamakihi）已适应了界限分明的栖息地生活，由此演化出高度特化的生理与行为特征，有助于该物种存活。

例句.英文: The Hawaiian archipelago is home to the kiwikiu (Pseudonestor xanthophrys), one of several bird species that can only be found on the islands.
例句.中文: 夏威夷群岛是 kiwikiu（毛岛雀）的家园——这是只能在夏威夷诸岛找到的鸟类物种之一。

义项: 名词 工匠；手艺人（凭手工技艺制作者）
[辨析] artisan 强调手工技艺，artist 强调艺术创作
搭配说明: artisanal — adj. 手工制作的（artisanal cheese / bread）
craftsmanship / craftsperson — n. 手艺 / n. 手艺人

例句.英文: This sped up the process of making clothing and, by freeing them from the need to push cord through holes manually, allowed artisans to make smaller holes and thus finer seams.
例句.原书高亮: allowed artisans to make smaller holes
例句.中文: 这加快了制衣流程，而且由于不必再手工把线绳穿过孔洞，工匠得以打出更小的孔，从而做出更细密的接缝。

例句.英文: And once the needle was invented, artisans could use finer cord and smaller holes, resulting in tighter, more thermally efficient seams in their clothing.
例句.中文: 而一旦发明了针，工匠便能使用更细的线和更小的孔，使衣物的接缝更紧密、保暖效率更高。

义项: 名词 集合；组合；聚集物
名词 器物组合——同一地点 / 层位出土的一批遗物（真题用法）
搭配说明: assemble — v. 聚集；装配、组装
assemblage ≠ assembly — 后者多指「装配；集会；（机械）组件」

例句.英文: The 6.5-million-year gap between these fossil assemblages occurs in the context of considerable evidence of concurrent African-Eurasian faunal exchange.
例句.中文: 在非洲与欧亚大陆同期动物群交流证据相当充分的背景下，这两组化石组合之间隔着 650 万年的空档。

例句.英文: Maltese lithic (stone implement) assemblages from the sixth and seventh millennia BCE exhibit notable characteristics.
例句.中文: 马耳他公元前六七千年的石制品组合展现出引人注目的特征。

义项: 名词 厌恶；反感（aversion to / toward X）
名词 loss aversion 损失厌恶——行为经济学核心概念
搭配说明: averse — adj. 不愿意的、厌恶的（averse to risk 厌恶风险）
aversion ≠ avert — avert 是动词「避免；转移（目光）」，同根不同词性

例句.英文: The finding that a loss is felt more keenly than is a gain of the same value led the researchers to formulate the concept of loss aversion, which has since informed research in fields ranging from behavioral economics to medicine.
例句.中文: 「同等价值的损失比收益让人感受更强烈」这一发现，促使研究者提出了「损失厌恶」的概念；此后这一概念影响了从行为经济学到医学等多个领域的研究。

例句.英文: They noted that it becomes more difficult for consumers to evaluate brand quality as line length increases and that consumers show high risk aversion during economic downturns.
例句.中文: 他们指出，产品线越长，消费者越难评估品牌质量；且消费者在经济下行期表现出高度的风险规避。

义项: 形容词 美丽的——beautiful 的古体 / 诗体写法
形容词 多见于莎士比亚及后世仿古文体，现代英语已罕用，但 SAT 常考这类「古语色彩词」
搭配说明: beauty / beauteous — n. 美 / adj. 美丽的（诗体）
fair / comely — adj. 美丽的——同为古语 / 文学色彩用词

例句.英文: There is a fair behaviour in thee, Captain; And though that nature with a beauteous wall Doth oft close in pollution, yet of thee I will believe thou hast a mind that suits With this thy fair and outward character.
例句.中文: 船长，你身上有一种美好的举止；虽然造化常以美丽的外墙把污秽包藏其中，但我仍愿相信你有一颗与这美好外表相匹配的心。

义项: 名词 common carp 鲤鱼；真题中作实验对象
动词 carp at / about 吹毛求疵、挑剔抱怨（书面义，与名词同形异义）

例句.英文: Prolonged exposure to anthropogenic noise (sounds from human sources like traffic or mining) can affect animals, as Lidia Eva Wysocki and colleagues found in a 2006 study of common carp.
例句.中文: 长期暴露于人为噪声（交通、采矿等人类来源的声音）会影响动物——Lidia Eva Wysocki 等人在 2006 年对鲤鱼的研究中便发现了这一点。

例句.英文: While bioaccumulation of manufactured nanoparticles may be inherently worrisome, it has been hypothesized that TiO₂-NP bioaccumulation in invertebrates like D. polymorpha could serve a valuable proxy role, obviating the need for manufacturers to conduct costly and intrusive sampling of vertebrate species—such as common carp (Cyprinus carpio), commonly used in regulatory compliance testing—for nanoparticle bioaccumulation, as environmental protection laws currently require.
例句.中文: 虽然人造纳米颗粒的生物累积本身可能令人担忧，但已有假设提出：斑马贝等无脊椎动物体内 TiO₂ 纳米颗粒的生物累积可发挥宝贵的指示作用，免去制造商对脊椎动物（如合规测试常用的鲤鱼）进行昂贵且具侵入性的采样——现行环保法律正要求此类检测。

义项: 形容词 经典的、被奉为正典的：被某个共同体公认为标准作品或标准版本
形容词 (引申义) （学科内）权威的、标准的（the canonical account 标准叙述）
[辨析] canonical ≠ classical：classical 指古希腊罗马或「古典」时期；canonical 指被后世奉入「正典」
搭配说明: canon — n. 正典；经典作品总目（the modernist canon 现代主义正典）
canonize — v. 把……奉为经典；（宗教）封圣

例句.英文: The fact that there is no contemporary evidence that the first audience of Arrival of the Train was alarmed has not stopped the story from becoming canonical, even among film historians.
例句.中文: 尽管没有当时的证据表明《火车进站》的首批观众曾被吓到，这并没有妨碍这个故事成为「正典」——即使在电影史学者中间也是如此。

例句.英文: Though now canonical, many works featured in the show—particularly one abstract cubist painting by Marcel Duchamp— ______ considered shocking at the time.
例句.中文: 尽管如今已被奉为经典，展览中的许多作品——尤其是杜尚的一幅抽象立体主义绘画——在当时却曾被认为惊世骇俗。

义项: 动词 双手交握、紧握；n. 扣子、搭扣
动词 hands clasped behind one's back 双手背在身后，是人物沉思 / 克制的经典体态描写

例句.英文: Don Mariano Alamar was silently walking up and down the front piazza of his house at the rancho; his hands listlessly clasped behind and his head slightly bent forward in deep thought.
例句.中文: 唐·马里亚诺·阿拉马尔在牧场宅邸前的门廊上默默来回踱步，双手无精打采地背扣在身后，头微微前倾，陷入沉思。

义项: 形容词 昼行性的、白天活动的（diurnal pollinators 白天活动的传粉昆虫）
形容词 (引申义) 以昼夜为周期的（diurnal temperature range 昼夜温差、气温日较差：一日内最高与最低气温之差）
[辨析] diurnal ↔ nocturnal：真题常成对出现，一个「白天活动」，一个「夜间活动」
搭配说明: nocturnal — adj. 夜行性的——与 diurnal 对照出题
diurnally — adv. 在白天

例句.英文: Researchers' focus on diurnal invertebrate pollinators has resulted in a decided lack of data on moth pollination, but using infrared detection equipment, Max Anderson et al. assessed how diurnal and nocturnal insects separately contribute to R. fruticosus pollination.
例句.中文: 研究者对白天活动的无脊椎传粉者的关注，导致蛾类传粉的数据明显缺乏；但 Max Anderson 等人利用红外探测设备，评估了昼行与夜行昆虫分别对 R. fruticosus 传粉的贡献。

例句.英文: Difficulties of documenting nocturnal pollinator visits and a general focus on diurnal invertebrate pollinators, such as Volucella bombylans, have resulted in ____ of information on nocturnal moth pollination of plants such as Rubus fruticosus L.
例句.中文: 记录夜间传粉者造访的困难，加上学界普遍聚焦于白天活动的无脊椎传粉者（如 Volucella bombylans），造成关于蛾类为 Rubus fruticosus L. 等植物夜间传粉的信息____。
